webhookDeploys.title: Webhook deploys
webhookDeploys.description: App-global pause for CI / push / scheduled deploys. Manual deploys from the UI or CLI keep working so you can still ship a fix.
webhookDeploys.scopeNoteLive: Webhook-fired deploys (push, CI, scheduled) accept normally. Pausing stops all three; manual deploys remain available.
webhookDeploys.scopeNotePaused: Webhook-fired deploys refused. Manual deploys, rollbacks, promotions, and teardown remain available.
webhookDeploys.confirmTitle: Pause webhook deploys for this app?
webhookDeploys.confirmDescription: Future deploys from CI, push events, and cron will be refused until you resume. Manual deploys from the UI or CLI continue to work.
webhookDeploys.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. CI is misfiring, holding until the upstream pipeline is fixed
webhookDeploys.reasonHelp: Recorded on the audit log and shown on this page until the pause is lifted. Up to 512 characters.

sendEmailDialog.description: Fires a one-shot test through this binding to verify the configured email transport. Bypasses unsubscribe; suppression list (hard-bounce / complaint) still applies.

sendEmailDialog.hint: On success, the toast carries the configured transport so you can confirm which provider received the call.

request.title: Request quota bump
request.description: Asks an org admin to raise the hard limit. They get an in-app notification + an email. Pending status surfaces on this row until decided.
request.reasonPlaceholder: Onboarding the prod team next quarter; current cap blocks the migration.
request.reasonHint: Required. Shows up in the admin notification.

mute.customDescription: Silence channel fan-out until the TTL expires. The rule keeps producing AlertEvent rows so the incident timeline stays intact. Mute is capped at 7 days.

mute.reasonHint: Surfaces on the audit log + on the muted-rule badge.
